feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 24 October 2026 5:31am
items.description:
##Today##

Heavy rain will arrive in the morning as strong to gale force winds develop, the rain clearing to isolated showers early evening. Severe gales later in evening/ overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 8°C and max. air temperature 14°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

10-25


##Wind Speed##

40


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

SW 15 backing South and increasing 30-40 gusts 50-60 through the morning/ early afternoon, veering West or SW later in day, becoming West 40-50 with gusts 60-70 later in evening/ overnight.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor in rain, becoming good later. Hill fog for a time.


##Comments##

Severe gales, with travel disruption and some damage. Heavy rain, risk localised flooding. Significant coastal overtopping in places at high tide (approx. 23:00), with a risk of some tidal flooding around harbours, most likely in Ramsey.


##Tomorrow##

Sunny intervals and isolated showers. The severe gales at first very gradually easing.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 8°C and max. air temperature 12°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-1


##Wind Speed##

35


##Wind Direction##

W


##Wind##

West 40-50 gusts 60-70 at first, gradually decreasing 25-30 gusts 40-45 by the evening, then backing and decreasing South or SW 15 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Comments##

Severe gales at first, but winds will very gradually ease through the period. Significant coastal overtopping in places at high tide (approx. 10:25 & 22:45).

##Comments##
